new_reviewed_notices.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
new_reviewed_notices.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
new_reviewed_notices.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.
new_reviewed_notices.detail: Function `canto_api.dashboard(p_action text, p_args jsonb)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/dashboard`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

review.pure_scalars: SECURITY INVOKER; built-in scalar expressions only, no relation access or dynamic SQL; private calls under fixed pg_catalog boundaries. SET search_path would disable required SQL inlining.
review.dashboard_dispatch: Authenticated callable by design, with live platform admin/session check before private context creation. Owner is NOLOGIN NOINHERIT NOBYPASSRLS. Anonymous and Squad roles have no EXECUTE. Denial/forged-context tests pass.
